attributes.originalText: The git command isn't available on this system, so I'll need to use Node.js and HTTPS requests instead. My plan is to fetch the repository's README or clone script to understand what it does, then adapt it for this device and sync it back to both AtomGit and GitHub.

attributes.originalText: I have the GitHub PAT and AtomGit tokens from the user. I'm weighing whether to push to both platforms or just one—the user specifically asked to sync to the remote repository at the latest version, so I'll start by fetching the repo to see what's actually in it. I'll use Node.js to make a GET request to the AtomGit API and examine the file structure.
